name: Newgrange - Ruins Structure
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: hellojaviergarcia
description: Newgrange is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by Ireland’s prehistoric passage tomb, featuring a great circular mound, hidden chambers, and mysterious stone carvings.
works: Newgrange is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by Ireland’s prehistoric passage tomb, featuring a great circular mound, hidden chambers, and mysterious stone carvings: its structures generate in new worlds.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged; a new world needed (structures generate with new chunks)
